title: An app true to its function!
body:
I’ve been app hunting for the appropriate app to help with my consistency in my routines, only depending on memory. But when I found this app, it actually saved my life!

As a student, I used to time-block my tasks by memory, but with the help of Routinery, it makes me realize how much time I could’ve saved all those years! I’m glad this app is a life-saver for me and will continue to use it!
author: ItsMattyx
